description: This Java class defines the OrderSetAttribute, a value object representing custom attributes associated with an OrderSet in the OpenMRS system. It extends BaseAttribute and implements Attribute, providing getter and setter methods for its properties and linking it to its owning OrderSet.

classes.name: OrderSetAttribute
classes.description: Represents a custom attribute for an OrderSet, including its ID and linkage to the parent OrderSet.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this attribute.

methods.name: setOrderSetAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this attribute.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Retrieves the OrderSet this attribute is associated with.

methods.name: setOrderSet
methods.description: Associates this attribute with a specific OrderSet.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieved the ID of this attribute, implementing OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this attribute, implementing OpenmrsObject.
